valid-3.2.0.reason: Swagger Parser 13.1.0 does not support OpenAPI 3.2.0.

invalid-schema-keyword.reason: Rust checks standard JSON Schema keyword types in OpenAPI 3.1; minLength must be an integer.

literal-reference.reason: Rust leaves example/default/extension payloads opaque; this Swagger fixture attempts to load a literal payload reference.

relative-schema-id.reason: Rust indexes relative schema resource IDs and anchors; this Swagger version rejects the plain-name fragment.

duplicate-operation-id.reason: Rust checks operationId uniqueness across the effective operation inventory.

missing-path-parameter.reason: Rust checks that each path template variable has a declared path parameter.
